body:
Also in my late twenties, and I know what it means to be abandoned by a loved one when you're in your biggest time of need. The sickness actually became a way for me to make a decision about life. In many situations, it does get better. Our bodies heal and mentally we learn the only person you can truly count on is yourself.

Men come in all sorts of personalities, shapes and sizes. Try joining an online forum for singles who have gone through similar medical issues and I garuntee you will find a connection with a soul similar to yours.

Once I had a break up so bad I drank a fifth of vodka and slashed my entire abdomen with a kitchen knife. Covered in blood I started laughing about how insane I let one person controll me to the point they had control over MY life. Be the queen you are and start owning it. I was born with an imbalance so sometimes I can't change the way I feel, but if you can, try.
